protocol: Development attempts, changing one or more identified failure mechanisms between runs. Not a frozen reliability cohort. Timing and sensor noise differ.
inputs: Public camera pixels, gyro/accelerometer, public timestamps/ACKs and own motor commands only. No native pose/course/race/actuator feedback in control or calibration.
scoring: Native values read postflight only. One fixed stationary-start yaw/origin frame; no candidate-specific alignment or scale fitting. Full-flight MAE includes startup and failures.
limits: Only one clean continuous5m/s attempt so far.8m/s failed at the first gate.
Position/map drift and depth error remain too large. Sub10 and high-accuracy full-state recovery are not achieved.
Motor output score compares own sent-channel model against raw reported channels, not measured RPM.
Exact input replay verifies determinism and input ownership, not estimator accuracy.
Scalar speed jerk is bounded; full Cartesian jerk is not thereby bounded.
Fixed8s startup allowance remains; camera exposure-to-command delay is unresolved.

protocol.mean: Frozen thrust-response.model.json. No mean, curve, lag or bias refit. Conditional body attitude, velocity, gyro bias and force-bias predictor starts from the last public controller posterior sent before each raw IMU receipt; propagate causally with public gyro and own commands only.
protocol.training_unit: Six declared pulse blocks: start-0.4s through end+1.0s, clipped at next pulse start to prevent duplicate samples. Only publicly airborne predictor states are eligible.
protocol.directional_covariance: base_sigma^2 I + k^2 a_net_body a_net_body^T, a_net_body = expected_specific_force + R_body^T gravity
protocol.fitting: Equal pulse-block average Gaussian negative log likelihood; no residual centering and no outlier removal. Leave-one-pulse-out CV. Free base in[0.05,5]m/s2 and k in[0,5]. Bounds are numerical, not learned from heldout.
protocol.selection: Lowest mean held-pulse negative log likelihood. Within0.02nats/sample prefer fewer fitted parameters, then larger base_sigma. Fit the selected model on all training blocks and freeze coefficients, source/model/input hashes before inspecting heldout.
protocol.statistics: Conditional normalized measurement residual q=r^T R^-1 r, not full EKF NIS because full prior cross-covariance is absent. Report Gaussian chi-square3 coverage at50/90/95/99%, meanq, RMS predicted/observed calibration, signed bias and heavy-tail frequency; regime bins for norm(a_net), phase and command change.
protocol.cadence_check: Also evaluate deterministic20Hz thinning at four public-time phases0/12.5/25/37.5ms. Do not select phase or change parameters from those results.
protocol.heldout_rule: No refit or fallback model selection. Report all frozen model comparisons. Selected model transfers provisionally only if mean NLL improves by>=0.1nat/sample over fixed0.5,95%coverage>=90%,99%coverage>=97%,and meanq in[1.5,6]. Otherwise reject as an uncalibrated heldout noise model.
protocol.limits: This estimates effective conditional prediction error, which includes model and state error. It is not intrinsic accelerometer noise and may double count prediction uncertainty if copied directly into an EKF R without checking HPH+R. Gaussian coverage is a diagnostic, not a guarantee. No native reference fields are loaded.

training.predictor: Last completed public posterior before this raw IMU receipt, causally propagated without the current force sample. Uses public R/v/gyro-bias/force-bias only. No native fields read.

heldout.predictor: Last completed public posterior before this raw IMU receipt, causally propagated without the current force sample. Uses public R/v/gyro-bias/force-bias only. No native fields read.

rejected_force_noise.interpretation: Conditional residual calibration; not full EKF NIS or intrinsic sensor noise.
